title: AeroMedQBank question file
description: A JSON array of questions. tools/validate.js enforces extra rules (subject must belong to the board, no duplicate stems, image files must exist).

status.description: AI-written or unchecked questions MUST be draft. Only a physician reviewer sets reviewed.

reviewedBy.description: Reviewer initials or name. Required in practice when status is reviewed.

subject.description: Must match a subject in data/manifest.json for one of the boards.

stem.description: Clinical vignette and question. Plain text; blank lines are kept.

image.description: Path under the site root, e.g. images/audiogram-01.png

imageAlt.description: Text description of the image. Required if image is set.

explanation.description: Why the answer is right, including the teaching point.

optionNotes.description: One sentence per option id explaining why it is right or wrong.

objectives.description: ABPM outline items covered, as board:code, e.g. aem:K1.E.1.
